card.name: Second half of hyphenated compound modifiers
card.fires_on: The ending of a compound modifier such as -driven, -intensive, -centered, -sensitive or -controlled, right after a noun or stem. It also fires on a few linking words like 'the' or 'attached' that follow a noun in technical phrases.

modes.label: Hyphenated -ed/-driven endings
modes.description: The closing part of a compound adjective that tells what something is driven, centered or controlled by.

modes.label: Split compound parts
modes.description: The middle or end of a technical compound broken into pieces, such as Self-Managing or performance-critical.

modes.label: Linking word after noun
modes.description: A small word that links a noun to what follows in a technical phrase.
modes.example: in the case of a network<< attached>> storage (NAS) enclosure

card.writes: It leans toward compound nouns and terms after the modifier, and away from software interface terms like GUI and UI.
card.plain: It marks the end of a hyphenated describing word, such as 'driven' in 'data-driven', when a noun is about to follow.
